notes: Expiration Date's initial-term length and end date are entirely redacted (years/months and the termination day/month), so present is true but the computed date is UNDETERMINED. Non-Compete is a borderline call: Section 4's exclusivity-of-endorsement clauses restrict Consultant's own competitive endorsement activity rather than imposing an exclusive-dealing obligation on Adams Golf, so it is coded Non-Compete rather than Exclusivity.
